programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying home ownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and JP Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

programme.title: Titans: The Rise of Hollywood
programme.desc: At the dawn of the 20th Century, immigrant entrepreneur Carl Laemmle looks to cash in on America's growing fascination with moving pictures; but as he starts to build an industry, he comes up against a powerful cartel headed by Thomas Edison.

programme.title: Titans: The Rise of Hollywood
programme.desc: To outdo his rivals, Laemmle builds a massive film factory in Hollywood called Universal City.

programme.title: Titans: The Rise of Hollywood
programme.desc: As Hollywood goes from a dusty farm town to a bustling metropolis, the balance of power shifts in favor of the stars; titans like Paramount's Zukor are now forced to pay huge contracts to top actors to keep them happy.

programme.title: Titans: The Rise of Hollywood
programme.desc: By 1925, Zukor's Paramount Pictures, Laemmle's Universal Pictures, and Mayer's MGM are some of the most profitable businesses in the country.

programme.title: Titans: The Rise of Hollywood
programme.desc: The Warners' film "The Jazz Singer" proves to the world that "talkies" are here to stay.

programme.desc: A busy lawyer (Jack Coleman) struggles to make time for his teen daughter (Cassi Thomson), and their relationship suffers. But when the man reconnects with his high-school bandmates, he sees positive changes in everyone. Directed by Ernie Barbarash.

programme.title: Horton Foote's 'Alone'
programme.desc: An elderly farmer (Hume Cronyn) who's contemplating retirement is pressured by his relatives to sell his property. Grey: James Earl Jones. Gus Jr.: Chris Cooper. Agnes: Hallie Foote. Jackie: Joanna Miles. Paul: David Selby. Estelle: Shelley Duvall. Carl: Frederic Forrest. Grace Ann: Roxanne Hart. Michael Lindsay-Hogg directed.

programme.title: Love Begins
programme.desc: An adventurer (Wes Brown) pays off a debt by working on a farm owned by a young woman (Julie Mond). As time passes and with nudging from the town's residents, the pair soon begin to fall for one another. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Leigh runs the popular website 'Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. When rival blogger Conner becomes the subject of one of her posts, they agree to date each other in order to prove which one is actually a bad dater.

programme.title: Romantically Speaking
programme.desc: A relationship expert's public love life goes on the rocks, so her best male friend steps in to help keep up appearances, and their relationship takes an interesting turn.

programme.title: Letter Never Sent
programme.desc: Henry discovers a love letter he wrote in high school to his best friend and attempts to share it to see if she feels the same way, but it ends up in her new boyfriends possession.

programme.title: Mixed Baggage
programme.desc: When Evie Jones rushes off a flight to make her connection, she has no idea that in her haste, she has grabbed the wrong duffel bag.

programme.title: Groomzilla
programme.desc: A newly engaged woman makes a wish that her fiancé takes the planning of their wedding seriously, and to her surprise and dismay, her wish comes true.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: A divorced mom (Lea Thompson) and her kids are forced to bunk with a single dad (Steven Brand) and his two children after a cabin mix-up at a resort in Scotland. Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Cupid, Inc.
programme.desc: A talk-show host receives a visit from a mysterious love expert, who promises he'll reveal her true love to her if she first helps other couples find each other. Her matchmaking efforts don't go smoothly, however, and she begins to question her task.

programme.title: My George
programme.desc: A struggling writer pens a romance novel, and then she searches for an ideal boyfriend like the one in her book to help her agent with publicity. Before long, she meets a charming real-estate agent and reconnects with an old high-school friend.

programme.title: Always and Forever
programme.desc: Former high-school sweethearts Grace and Michael (Rena Sofer and Dean McDermott) reconnect at their 20-year high-school reunion. Sparks fly, but the pair are hesitant to jump into a relationship that already failed once. Grace's mom (Barbara Eden), meanwhile, is quick to offer her two cents on her daughter's romantic woes. Max Gail and Rob Boltin also star. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Wedding planner Abby specializes in fixing weddings that went wrong, but when she is forced to work with her ex-fiancé, she begins to question whether their relationship was the disaster she remembers.

programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: March 25, 2006 Ruth Galloway is a well-to-do socialite who's not quite as secure inside as she seems from the outside. When a young woman named Billy saves her life, Ruth decides to turn her mansion into a shelter for the city's homeless.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.desc: A woman seeking romance finds an ideal man online, but she gets a surprise when she meets him and learns that his young son was posing as his dad and communicating with her.

programme.title: Straight From the Heart
programme.desc: A singles ad leads to an unlikely courtship between a Big Apple photographer (Teri Polo) and a widowed Wyoming rancher (Andrew McCarthy). Patricia Kalember, Greg Evigan. Carla: Christine Tucci. Howard: J. Kenneth Campbell. Jesse: David Jean-Thomas.

programme.title: Once Upon a Date
programme.desc: A real-estate broker tasked with buying a community playhouse falls for the owner's daughter.

programme.title: You've Got a Friend
programme.desc: Dylan McLaughlin plays Bobby, a boy who recently lost his parents and finds solace in box-car racing with help from the town loner (John Schneider), a former derby racer himself. But victory doesn't come easy for Bobby as he is forced to confront a bully and disapproval from his uncle (Jason Brooks). Miss Nelson: Bitty Schram.

programme.title: The Wish List
programme.desc: A perfectionist (Jennifer Esposito) makes a list of the qualities she's looking for in a mate and soon finds a seemingly ideal guy (Mark Deklin). But she's also drawn to a kooky barista (David Sutcliffe) who encourages her to loosen up and explore her creative side. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: Love Finds a Home
programme.desc: Dr. Belinda Owens (Sarah Jones) cares for her pregnant friend, whose opinionated mother-in-law (Patty Duke) resists Belinda's scientific approach to medicine. Adding to Belinda's worries is her own desire, but seeming inability, to become pregnant. Haylie Duff and Jordan Bridges also star. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: Touched
programme.desc: A young nurse who takes a job as a live-in caretaker for a cantankerous, dying novelist discovers the secret of why the elderly woman is estranged from her son, and sets out to do something about it.

programme.title: Same Time Next Week
programme.desc: When Christy meets Charlie, they discover that they have a lot in common than their lost spouses.

programme.title: A Taste of Romance
programme.desc: A classically trained chef (Teri Polo) feels the heat of competition when a retired fireman (James Patrick Stuart) opens a restaurant next to hers. Though they clash initially, the pair soon strike up a friendship with help from the man's precocious daughter (Bailee Madison). Directed by Lee Rose.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The 2025 Stanley Cup Final, tied at 1-1, takes the Panthers and Oilers to Florida for Game 3. After Corey Perry scored with 18 seconds left to tie the game, Brad Marchand broke hearts with his double-overtime tally to give Florida a 5-4 Game 2 win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final

programme.title: Merry Swissmas

programme.title: Crazy Racing

programme.title: Jurassic World

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom

programme.title: Paddington in Peru

programme.title: Flow

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie

programme.title: Dune: Part Two

programme.title: Bottoms

programme.title: Couples Therapy

programme.title: Couples Therapy

programme.title: The Secret Garden

programme.title: No One Will Save You

programme.title: The Chi

programme.title: Long Bright River

programme.title: Cora Bora

programme.title: Akilla's Escape
